criteria.text: Memory search is enabled only through an ephemeral, server-enforced, read-only, query-only capability scoped to current consent and server-enforced user/server/profile/canonical-vault/runtime-generation identity. It validates a loopback endpoint, canonical root, and current index; rejects traversal, symlink escape, stale-index results, redirects, and remote endpoints; revokes immediately on identity/generation change or disposal; and is disabled absent the capability. Search output has bounded count/snippet length, opaque IDs only, and explicitly untrusted labels/content. Renderer never supplies identity/path/value; IPC is closed-schema with strict size/enums and validates ownsDocument, main-frame, trusted URL, authentication, and ownership, rejecting unauthenticated/non-owning senders. Every grant mutation requires exact-mutation native main-owned confirmation.
